CI: add focused audience browser artifact-reuse lane (#882)

## Scope

Adds a diagnostic-only focused audience browser lane for complete
checker-harness deltas. It may consume only a qualified canonical Pages
artifact for the PR base; it never replaces canonical exact-head Site
qualification.

## Current authority and landing topology

- current authority base:
`site@e2f7f8ed01221a7e067fcdf557650362cdb0b964`
- landed dependency: #881 reviewed head
`8ffc0b47caa4a6e87f8ea7b9e71e1581d43f3b65`, merge
`e2f7f8ed01221a7e067fcdf557650362cdb0b964`
- this PR head: `006ef2917f454ddeef0474db0987ec376d797b51`
- pre-landing stack: `site@ba5025…` → #881 → #882; current #882 diff is
only its focused diagnostic/artifact-reuse responsibility.

## P2 remediation

The prior whole-stack Codex review was bound to
`b7a248f2c707fd0d72b8a75f8a5633a504bebc25`, not this refreshed head. Its
attempt-binding finding is repaired: before reuse, the selector parses
required GitHub timestamps, verifies the selected successful build
attempt has an ordered time window, and requires `build.started_at <=
artifact.created_at <= build.completed_at`. Malformed, missing,
reversed, or stale attempt evidence fails closed. Coverage includes a
stale artifact from an older rerun attempt, a valid time-bound artifact,
malformed/missing timestamps, and a reversed attempt window. Existing
digest, run/head, input identity, provenance, provider revision, and
archive-safety checks remain intact. Both P2 finding threads have
remediation replies and are resolved.

## Exact validation

- Local focused classifier/artifact/workflow tests: passing (49 tests),
including direct helper execution and module import coverage.
- Local fast preflight structural checks: passing; its full core-test
phase is blocked in this runtime because Python 3.12 has no `pip` and
the required `pygments` package is absent.
- Exact-head canonical CI: `Validate Website contracts` `35096861453` —
success; `Build documentation artifact` `35096861972` — success.
- Retarget assessment: #881's merge commit is tree-identical to its
reviewed head, so the #882 complete diff, full-qualification
applicability, and exact-head check results are unchanged; no conflict
or workflow/input change occurred.
- The focused lane is contract-tested only in this PR; it was not
exercised end-to-end because this complete PR delta includes
CI-control/artifact-selector changes and is deliberately ineligible for
the harness-only shortcut.

Canonical exact-head Site CI remains the acceptance authority.
